metadata.datasource: Measured off Polaroid Corporation, Polapan Pro 100 B&W T-54, T-554, T-664 and T-804, Film Data Sheet (1999): the print's characteristic curve at 70 F (21 C), its spectral sensitivity and its MTF, vector plots. A positive and the print at once, seen by reflection: the curve is the print's density, D-min 0.100 (the paper's white) to D-max 1.72. Mid-grey where it reads the sheet's reference density, 0.75 (18% grey on a print), on the sheet's relative axis; the pack carries the sheet's prints at 55 F and 95 F (13 and 35 C) too, its cold and hot processing. The spectral sensitivity continues past its plotted ends at its own final gradient and is balanced so an 18% grey exposes it to 1. Filter factors in daylight and tungsten from it: Wratten 47 8.4 and 16.4 (sheet 6.3 and 11.2); Wratten 58 12.4 and 10.7 (sheet 10.0 and 11.2); Wratten 8 2.3 and 1.5 (sheet 2.0 and 1.4); Wratten 25 4.6 and 2.4 (sheet 5.6 and 2.8). One silver layer, carried as three identical channels.
